title: A great day in Granada
text: We enjoyed this tour very much! Ruben is a wonderful tour guide very knowledgeable and friendly. The experience was amazing!
author: Iris_G

title: Walking in Granada
text: We decided to do a private tour so my husband wouldn't have to do a lot of uphill walking. Vicente was our tour guide and he was excellent. He was so knowledgeable about Granada and the Albaicin and Sacromonte areas. He gave us a great tour and we were able to visit a cave which I had really wanted to do. He modified the walking tour so that we could end up back at the restaurant where we had dinner reservations. I would highly recommend him and this tour!
author: Q3950VQkathyg
